substeps.caption: The door, drawn see-through, swings open on its right-hand hinge. The goniometer stands still at its load position: nothing moves inside until the door is locked and the X-rays are on.
The prepared holder goes onto the stage by hand: a zero-background plate, single-crystal Si, with the powder struck off flush in its well, so the powder's face is on the goniometer's axis.
Door shut and DOOR LOCK pressed.
Only then does the interlock let the 600 W tube switch on: the X-ray lamp on top lights.
The goniometer drives to its start, theta 5 deg and 2theta 10 deg, and the shutter opens: the incident beam from the tube on the left.
The scan, the housing drawn see-through: the tube stays put, the sample tilts by theta and the detector on the right sweeps 2theta from 10 to 90 deg, counting the diffracted beam.
Shutter shut and X-rays off, the lamp out; the goniometer goes back to its load position. The door stays locked until then.
Door shut. At 722 mm tall the MiniFlex just fits a tray: Kardex allows 727.5 mm.
